sprint: Image Studio Redesign — kid-friendly 2-view flow (Result + Edit) + tile toolbar with sub-panels, mirroring the standalone tools/background-remover/ UX, per the user's own governing request: 'we need to redo this UI so its easier like we changed the background-remover easy to use options. the background remover button in this UI is not working.' Result View leads with a big canvas + two large CTAs (Looks Great / Make It Better). Make It Better swaps to Edit View, a 6-tile grid (Remove Background / Turn or Flip / Bigger or Smaller / Brighten / Peek Original / Start Over). Clicking a tile opens a contextual sub-panel below it; a second click on the same tile closes it; clicking a different tile switches. Brighten is a one-tap toggle that adds .active without opening any panel. Peek Original is a hold gesture (mousedown adds .active, mouseup removes it). Start Over resets Brighten's own .active plus the currently-open sub-panel. The Back link returns to Result View; Save Picture applies the result and closes. The reported bug — Remove Background button stuck disabled — was root-caused as a missing _refreshBgControls() call after every _origImg=img assignment inside open()'s three load paths (HTMLImageElement, string via loadImg, File via FileReader), so the button's disabled state never re-synced against the freshly-loaded image; fixed by adding the refresh at all 3 sites, so the button correctly reads its worker-availability and image-loaded gates the moment a real picture arrives. Verified 53/53 via image_studio_redesign_verify.js (Result View default with 2 CTAs, Looks Great applies+closes, Make It Better switches views, all 6 tiles present in correct order, tile click toggle mechanics, Remove Background button genuinely enabled — the reported bug fix, Brighten one-tap toggle, Peek Original hold, Start Over reset, Back/Save round trip, re-open state reset). Full regression: both goldenBuild suites (v1 and v2) PASS unchanged. Public PictureStudio.open() API preserved byte-for-byte — every one of the 7 existing call sites (js/app.js, js/contextPanel.js, js/pageDesigner.js) works with zero change.
task: Rebuilt js/pictureStudio.js's modal structure: new state variables (_view, _activeTool, _tileButtons, _subPanels), _buildModal now composes Result View (big canvas + .picture-studio-cta-btn primary/secondary CTAs) and Edit View (6 .picture-studio-tile buttons in a .picture-studio-tool-grid + 4 .picture-studio-subpanel elements — bg, flip, resize, brighten). _setView(v) sets data-view on the root; _toggleActiveTool(tool) sets data-active-tool + .active on the matching tile. Brighten is handled inline in the tile click handler (no sub-panel). Peek Original uses mousedown/mouseup listeners for the hold gesture.
